password.title: Password

rollback.title: Roll back the archive

open.refused: {name} (.{extension}) is not opened directly; it is shown in the preview pane.

preview.link: A link. It has no content to preview.
preview.text.label: Text of the entry
preview.hex.label: Bytes of {name}

pick.destination: Choose where the new archive goes
actions.label: Actions
notices.label: Notices
notice.held: {name} is held by another program, so an interrupted write could not be finished ({tries} tries). LitePack will try again at the next start.
notice.failed: {name}: an interrupted write could not be cleaned up ({error}). LitePack will try again at the next start.
notice.settings: Your settings could not be read, so the defaults are in use ({error}).
notice.refused: LitePack could not follow a request from another window: {error}
verb.test: Testing archives is not in this version yet; lpk test does it from a command prompt.
verb.convert: Converting an archive to .lpk is not in this version yet.
notice.gaveup: {name} was left as it is: an interrupted write could not be finished after {tries} tries. Check it with lpk test.
extract.title: Extract {name}
extract.dest.smart: Smart: beside the archive, in a new folder when needed
extract.dest.newfolder: A new folder beside the archive
extract.leftout: {count} selected items are hidden by the filter and are left out.
extract.conflict: {count} items already exist in {folder}. What should happen to them?
extract.cancelled.kept: {name}: cancelled. Any files already extracted were kept in {folder}.
extract.skipped: {count} items were skipped because they already existed.
extract.renamed: {count} items were written under a new name.
extract.check.blake3: Checked: every file matched its BLAKE3 hash.
extract.check.members: Checked: each member matched its stored checksum.
extract.check.partial: Checked: {matched} members matched their stored checksum; {none} had none to check.
extract.check.unverifiable: Not verifiable: this format stores nothing to check against.
extract.motw: Some files could not be marked as downloaded from the internet on this drive.
extract.links.unprivileged: Links not created, because this account may not create them: {list}
extract.refusal: {name}: this archive needs {needed}; this PC allows {allowed}.
extract.disk: Not enough room: this needs {needed} bytes and only {free} bytes are free.
recents.label: Recent archives
create.title: New archive
create.name.label: Archive name
create.name.exists: {name} already exists in this folder. Choose another name or folder.
create.folder.none: No folder yet: add something, or choose one.
create.tier.fast.about: Quick to make and to open. A good size.
create.tier.balanced.about: Smaller, takes longer to make. Opens quickly.
create.tier.store.about: No compression: the files as they are, in one archive.
create.password.none: No password: anyone can open the archive.
create.password.prompt: Choose a password for the new archive:
create.recovery.label: Recovery records (percent, 0 to 20)
create.recovery.hint: Extra data that can repair a damaged archive. 0 adds none.
create.test.label: Test when done
create.summary.done: Created {name}: {entries} entries, {bytesIn} bytes in, {bytesOut} bytes out{saved}, in {time}.
create.summary.encrypted: Encrypted with a password; file names can be listed without it.
create.summary.encrypted.names: Encrypted with a password, file names included.
create.summary.command.note: The equivalent lpk command. The password is not included: lpk asks for it. Select the line and copy it.
create.test.cancelled: The test was cancelled; the archive was kept without it.
